description: Run regal fix to automatically apply mechanical fixes. Regal 0.42 fixes opa-fmt, use-rego-v1, use-assignment-operator, no-whitespace-comment, directory-package-mismatch, non-raw-regex-pattern, prefer-equals-comparison, redundant-existence-check and constant-condition; older releases fix a subset. Use dryRun: true to preview changes before modifying files. NOTE: directory-package-mismatch moves files to match their package path -- use disable: ["directory-package-mismatch"] to skip it. Regal before 0.41 refuses files with uncommitted git changes unless force: true. Requires regal.

configFile.description: Path to a Regal config file (.regal/config.yaml).

disable.description: Disable specific fix rules. Useful to skip directory-package-mismatch if you do not want files moved.

disableCategory.description: Disable all rules in a category.

dryRun.description: Preview what would be fixed without modifying any files. Recommended before the first real run.

enableCategory.description: Enable all rules in a category.

force.description: On Regal before 0.41, allow fixing files that have uncommitted git changes; those releases refuse them otherwise. Regal 0.41 removed that check, and the flag is not sent to it.

ignoreFiles.description: Glob patterns to exclude from fixing.

paths.description: Policy files or directories to fix. Each must be inside an allowed root (OPA_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS).

name: rego_fix
title: Auto-fix Rego violations
